references.text: The same principle of the death penalty for anyone who curses their father or mother is repeated in Leviticus, as part of the Holiness Code.
A curse is pronounced against anyone who dishonors their father or mother, which underscores the seriousness of despising one's parents.
The fifth commandment requires honoring father and mother, and cursing them is the opposite of this commandment.
Proverbs warns that whoever curses their father or mother will have their lamp extinguished in darkness.
Describes a generation that curses its father and does not bless its mother, as an example of sinful behavior.
Jesus cites this commandment when he confronts the Pharisees about their tradition that undermines the command to honor parents.
Mark recounts Jesus' reference to this commandment in the discussion about the Korban tradition and its conflict with God's command.
